text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The concert moves a fan to tears. It would seem that Mihono Bourbon's emotions got across.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She delivered the kind of moving performance she once saw Smart Falcon give. The team gets a boost in morale.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We've heard from more and more people who see their own dreams in the goal we're working towards. Our project, however, is not without its detractors.
